title: Biblical literacy survey tracker data
description: Published survey figures on Bible importance, reading, knowledge and views in the United States, one row per published figure, as used on Christian Curator's biblical literacy page. Surveys are not merged; each row keeps its own question, sample and field dates.

quiz_groups.label: Story order

Let Bible Reading Get Back to Basics

changelog.note: Added the reverence gap chart (Pew Religious Landscape Study), the Lifeway quiz chart and five-question check, and this survey tracker. Pew, Lifeway and Gallup are plotted; Barna and American Bible Society are cited as text pending permission.
Data watch added 2 cited figures from Lifeway Research to the data watch table (quoted from the linked source, not charted).

pew-rls-bible-importance.study_title: 2023-24 Religious Landscape Study, chapter 7: Importance of religion and the Bible
pew-rls-bible-importance.mode: Address-based sample conducted for Pew by NORC; completed online, by mail or by phone
pew-rls-bible-importance.margin_of_error: plus or minus 0.8 percentage points (national sample); higher for subgroups
pew-rls-bible-importance.license_note: Pew terms allow reuse with attribution and no implied endorsement; analyses of Pew data carry Pew's disclaimer.
pew-rls-bible-importance.verified_from: Table 'Most evangelicals and members of historically Black Protestant churches say the Bible is extremely or very important to them', report PDF p. 160; question BIBIMP in the RLS topline.

pew-rls-practices.study_title: 2023-24 Religious Landscape Study: Prayer, reading scripture and other religious practices
pew-rls-practices.mode: Address-based sample conducted for Pew by NORC; completed online, by mail or by phone
pew-rls-practices.margin_of_error: plus or minus 0.8 percentage points (national sample); higher for subgroups
pew-rls-practices.license_note: Pew terms allow reuse with attribution and no implied endorsement; analyses of Pew data carry Pew's disclaimer. Pew says 2007 and 2014 results for this question are not comparable because of the change in survey mode.
pew-rls-practices.verified_from: Table 'Most Latter-day Saints read scripture outside of church at least weekly', report PDF p. 186; question PRAC item b in the RLS topline.

lifeway-quiz-2026.study_title: 2 in 3 Churchgoers Fail Bible Literacy Quiz (Bible Literacy 2026)
lifeway-quiz-2026.population: U.S. adults who identify as Protestant/nondenominational, Catholic or Orthodox Christian and attend church in a typical month
lifeway-quiz-2026.license_note: Lifeway: studies 'can be used and referenced in news articles freely'; the release may be republished in its entirety without permission. Our own chart, cited and linked.
lifeway-quiz-2026.verified_from: News release text; per-item values for Philemon, Hezekiah, Haggar and the Gospel of Thomas from the Lifeway frequencies report PDF (Q54).

lifeway-genz-2025.study_title: Gen Z Churchgoers Attend More but Often Lag in Application (State of Discipleship)
lifeway-genz-2025.population: U.S. Protestant/nondenominational adults who attend services at least once a month
lifeway-genz-2025.license_note: Lifeway releases may be used and referenced freely. Our own chart, cited and linked.
lifeway-genz-2025.verified_from: News release text. Generations: Gen Z 18 to 28, Millennials 29 to 44, Gen X 45 to 60, Boomers and above 61 and older.

gallup-bible-views-2022.study_title: Fewer in U.S. Now See Bible as Literal Word of God
gallup-bible-views-2022.margin_of_error: plus or minus 4 percentage points (2022 wave)
gallup-bible-views-2022.license_note: Our own chart drawn from the figures Gallup publishes, cited and linked; no Gallup graphic is reproduced.
gallup-bible-views-2022.verified_from: Table 'Americans' Views of the Bible' on the article page; wave dates from Gallup's topline PDF (https://news.gallup.com/file/poll/394616/220706ViewsofBible.pdf).

barna-bible-reading-2025.study_title: How Millennials and Gen Z Are Driving a Bible Reading Comeback (State of the Church 2025, with Gloo)
barna-bible-reading-2025.field_dates: January to October 2025 (2025 data); tracking since 2000
barna-bible-reading-2025.sample: 12,116 online interviews in 2025; 138,556 adults across the 25-year series
barna-bible-reading-2025.mode: Online and telephone interviews, quota samples
barna-bible-reading-2025.margin_of_error: not published on the source page
barna-bible-reading-2025.license_note: Barna requires a written request for web use beyond presentations and papers (permissions@barna.com). Cited as text only until permission is granted.
